messages:
Jules: Putting a compact manager checklist here for incoming hire Taylor (start Mon 2025-06-02). Want something copy-paste friendly for managers.

Jules: MANAGER QUICK START (copyable):
- 72h before: confirm laptop + MDM, add to payroll, share Slack + org chart.
- 24h before: send welcome email with Day 1 logistics + 1:1 invite.
- Day 1: 15m team roll call, 45m 1:1 (expectations + 30/60/90), 2h dev-env pairing with buddy.
- Day 2: access review (Sentry/Datadog/IAM), open IAM ticket for prod if needed.
- Day 3-5: assign two small onboarding tasks (docs + small bug).
- End week 1: manager posts initial 30/60/90 goals and schedules 30m review.

Priya: Add a line: confirm 2FA + company SSO enrollment. Also check badge pickup/shipping.

Marcus: Facilities (badge) is on me. I'll request badge and post tracking. For hardware, contact Keiko in Ops.

Sam: I'll be the buddy. Will host Day 1 pairing and create a sample PR task. Recommend short daily check-ins first 3 days.

BadgeBot: Reminder: Badge requests take 3 business days. Submit by Friday for next-week starts. Link: https://redwood.internal/facilities/badge-request

Jules: Copy-paste 1:1 invite text for managers:
Subject: Welcome Taylor  1:1 Kickoff
When: Mon 10:00 AM (30m)
Agenda: intros, immediate priorities, 30/60/90 expectations, Qs

Priya: For 30/60/90, managers should set one measurable objective per milestone and share in writing. Sample: 30d = dev env + test suite passing + 1 merged PR.

Marcus: Security note: any prod creds require IAM ticket + manager approval. No ad-hoc sharing.

Sam: Done: recurring buddy invites Mon-Fri 10:30-11:00 for week 1. Added dev-env checklist to the onboarding doc.

Jules: Great. If no objections by EOD I'll mark this as the canonical manager quick-start for Taylor and paste into the hire packet.

Priya: No objections. :thumbsup:

Marcus: All good from Facilities side. Badge requested.

BadgeBot: Onboarding packet emailed to taylor@example.com (automated).
